info.title: API-DocTest-List Retail Orders Tracks-v3-spec
info.description: The Retail Order Tracking API provides businesses with the capability to monitor the status of retail orders throughout the fulfillment process. This endpoint allows users to retrieve real-time tracking information specific to their orders, thereby enhancing the order management experience. Typical consumers include e-commerce platforms, logistics providers, and customer service teams who need timely updates on order statuses to ensure optimal customer satisfaction. By utilizing this API, users can effectively manage order tracking and improve operational efficiencies.

get.summary: Track the status of an order.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to track the current status of their orders by providing the relevant order ID. Users will receive updates on the order's progress, shipment, and delivery details.

requestBody.description: The request body for tracking an order. This body must contain the necessary information required to retrieve the tracking details associated with a specific order.

ListRetailOrdersTracksRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to tracking orders.

ListRetailOrdersTracksResponse_200.title: Order Tracking Response

status.description: Indicates whether the tracking operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the order.

resultId.description: A unique identifier for the result of the tracking operation.

state.description: The current state of the order being tracked.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the tracking request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the tracking operation.

ListRetailOrdersTracksResponse_200.description: Response schema for tracking an order, containing the status and details of the tracking operation.

AuditDetails.title: Audit Details

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that created the tracking entry.

createdAt.description: The timestamp of when the tracking entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the tracking entry was created automatically.

AuditDetails.description: Detailed information about the audit of the tracking operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time taken by the server to process the request, measured in milliseconds.
